1.note: Unidentified; transliterated. Probably an author of astronomical or chronological tables.

2.note: The arithmetic requires 318 (318+1571=1889), so שי"ה (315) is probably a misprint for שי"ח. Note that 323−6=317.

3.note: Unidentified chronicler; transliterated rather than guessed.

4.note: This is the well-known Epistle of Rav Sherira Gaon. The Arukh (s.v. Abaye) cites a shorter responsum.

5.note: Standard texts of the Epistle give 590 SE for R. Yohanan's death; the number is kept as printed.

6.note: 4725 AM (c. 965 CE) does not exactly match 1279 SE (c. 967/8 CE); the author nevertheless treats the two as agreeing.

7.note: Sense uncertain; rendered "in tables." It may instead mean "in summary" or "in full detail."

8.note: The figure is reproduced as cited. Rabbinic chronology usually places the start of Greek rule about 34 years after the rebuilding of the Temple.
